notes_for_editor: Only one register entry and one volunteer map tag describe this site. The register gives no build year beyond 'the 1950s', so no built event was written (the schema needs a year and none is in the sources). Status 'standing' rests on the register's present-tense text; no recent photo or report was read. Access is unknown and no access key was written. Both WebSearch results for 'Green Mountain lookout' were mostly about Green Mountain Lookout in Washington State, a different tower, and were excluded. The firelookout.ca page shows only N/A fields for this site and is not cited. Used 2 WebSearch and 4 page reads.
